reason: 55 CZK for one can is a lot when I can get YEAHRBA mate on Rohlík cheaper with my weekly groceries, and my pre-workout from GymBeam costs far less per serving. I'd need a real reason to pay extra and order from yet another e-shop.
objection: Every brand says natural now. I don't see what makes this better than the mate I can already add to my Rohlík basket for less, and 80 mg is about what a regular energy can gives me anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on Rohlík or GymBeam at around 40 CZK, or a free can at my gym so I can taste whether it's actually better than YEAHRBA.
